title: Wangari Maathai
examples: What did Wangari Maathai do to help the environment?
How did the Green Belt Movement start?
What was the main goal of her work?

explain.say: Wangari Maathai started a group called the Green Belt Movement.

draw.text: Green Belt Movement started by Wangari Maathai.

explain.say: This movement encouraged people to plant trees in their local areas.
Planting trees helps stop soil erosion and keeps the air clean.

draw.text: Trees stop soil erosion and clean air.

explain.say: Her dedication to environmental action earned her the Nobel Peace Prize.

draw.text: Nobel Peace Prize for environmental work.

explain.say: In everyday life, we can help by recycling materials correctly.

draw.text: Recycling helps reduce waste and pollution.

faq.q: What was the Green Belt Movement?
faq.a: It was an environmental movement founded by Wangari Maathai. It focused on empowering local communities to protect their environment by planting trees.
asks: What did the Green Belt Movement do?
Tell me about the Green Belt Movement.

faq.q: Why is planting trees so important for the environment?
faq.a: Trees help prevent soil erosion, which means the good topsoil does not wash away. They also clean the air we breathe.
asks: How do trees help the soil?
What is the benefit of planting trees?

faq.q: Did she win the Nobel Peace Prize for planting trees?
faq.a: Yes, she received the Nobel Peace Prize for her environmental activism. The prize recognized her efforts to unite people for environmental protection.
asks: What did she win the Nobel Prize for?

faq.q: Is she only famous for Kenya?
faq.a: While she is strongly associated with Kenya, her work inspired environmental movements globally. Her ideas about community action are universal.
asks: Did she work in other countries?
Is her impact limited to Africa?

faq.a: Environmentalism means caring about and protecting the natural world around us. It involves actions to keep nature healthy for everyone.

facts: Wangari Maathai founded the Green Belt Movement in Kenya.
The movement encouraged local communities to plant trees.
Her work highlighted the link between environmental health and peace.
She received the Nobel Peace Prize in 2002.

quiz.say: The Green Belt Movement focused on:
quiz.show: Protecting the environment through community action.

options.show: Planting trees to restore local ecosystems.
options.say: Planting trees to restore local ecosystems.

quiz.why: This shows the core action of the movement.

wrong.0: This is an activity, but it is not the main action of the movement.
wrong.1: While activism is involved, the focus was environmental, not purely political.
wrong.2: Education is important, but the movement's primary method was physical restoration.

quiz.say: What does the Nobel Peace Prize recognize in this context?

options.show: Efforts linking environmental health to peace.
options.say: Efforts linking environmental health to peace.

quiz.why: The prize acknowledged that environmental damage causes conflict.

wrong.0: The award was for active, real-world change, not just documentation.
wrong.1: While she did this, the award specifically highlighted the link between nature and peace.
wrong.3: The prize recognized social and political action, not just pure science.

quiz.why: Roots physically bind the soil together, preventing erosion.
